message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner, and our options are built around exactly that: a clear price, a firm lead time and payment terms you can plan with.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the cost side:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the strongest payment term of the three, and it ties the price and lead time together in one arrangement that is easy to plan around.

We would like to build a dependable relationship for the HX series, and we hope you will look at Option A seriously. If another structure would help your planning, tell us which of the options comes closest.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On price:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives your machines steady, clearly defined work on a part that matters to us, at a price that reflects what we see elsewhere. We would rather build this with you than with a stranger, and we think it is fair for both family companies.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

If Option A works for you, please tell us. We are glad to talk it through personally.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

You gave us a clear price and invited us to write if anything was unclear, so I will be just as direct: we want to find a fair solution for both family companies on the pump shaft for the new HX series.

On the cost side:
Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve. It answers the gap on price and, with a fair payment term and an unchanged lead time, gives your team a clear and plannable basis for this part. Option B is a genuine alternative if a different balance suits your company better.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

We know what Hollerau means to you as a reference customer, and we have valued working with Drehteile Fuchsreiter. That is why we are setting out our position openly and in one step, rather than in a long exchange. We would like to settle this part with you, owner to owner.

I look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we checked the steel prices and you are right about the drop, so we can lower our price to €31.00. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Our current offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Alternatively, under our standard terms, we offer a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit. We have to keep the 52 days lead time, because doing 35 days means express shifts and that would actually make the price go up a lot! We are working hard on our delivery performance, and 52 days is a safe plan for both of us with 45 days payment.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

move.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for that and for moving again on price. Option A keeps that spirit: it is built around how we pay you, and the price follows from it.

On the cost side:
Another supplier has offered EUR 28.00 for this part (offer:70210-2).

We are not asking you to match a rival quote for its own sake. We want a fair solution for two family companies that have worked together reliably, and Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a clear payment term and a set lead time, and it brings the price into the range where we can place this part with confidence.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.98; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option B is a genuine alternative if a different payment term suits you better. We would be glad to settle this with you personally, as owner to owner.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
